findings.description: '/etc/pam.d/ubuntils-lab' uses pam_permit.so in a way that can grant authentication on its own (it short-circuits the stack, or no other module can fail it) — a common backdoor technique to bypass authentication for a service
findings.guided_remediation: Review /etc/pam.d/ubuntils-lab: remove the pam_permit.so line, or restore the `requisite pam_deny.so` gate in front of it

signals.detail: pam_permit.so can decide the auth/account stack — read from the PAM config, not inferred
signals.name: content_match

findings.title: PAM config unconditionally permits authentication
